tvShow.name: Monarch: Legacy of Monsters
tvShow.overview: After surviving Godzilla's attack on San Francisco, Cate is shaken yet again by a shocking secret. Amid monstrous threats, she embarks on a globetrotting adventure to learn the truth about her family—and the mysterious organization known as Monarch.

episodes.name: Aftermath
episodes.overview: Cate travels to Japan to get answers about her father and uncovers a shocking secret. Keiko, Lee, and Billy pursue a theory about Titans.

episodes.name: Departure
episodes.overview: Monarch closes in on Cate, Kentaro, and May as they try to track down a key individual. Keiko, Lee, and Billy stumble on a major find.

episodes.name: Secrets and Lies
episodes.overview: Shaw leads the team on a dangerous mission to Alaska in search of Hiroshi. Keiko, Lee, and Billy present their findings to General Puckett.

episodes.name: Parallels and Interiors
episodes.overview: The team is left stranded in the frozen tundra after a narrow escape. Kentaro reflects on his relationships.

episodes.name: The Way Out
episodes.overview: Cate's painful memories of G-Day come flooding back as she treks through the ruins of San Francisco with Kentaro and May.

episodes.name: Terrifying Miracles
episodes.overview: Shaw finds an unlikely ally within Monarch as the team has a harrowing run-in. Keiko and Lee grow closer while at a military ball.

episodes.name: Will the Real May Please Stand Up?
episodes.overview: May finally faces her past. Duvall and Shaw follow traces of Godzilla and Hiroshi.

episodes.name: Birthright
episodes.overview: The team goes back to where things all began to confront Shaw. On the brink of collapse, Monarch takes drastic measures.

episodes.name: Axis Mundi
episodes.overview: Shaw and May search for Cate and make a startling discovery. Kentaro struggles with his loss.

episodes.name: Beyond Logic
episodes.overview: The team struggles to find a way out of Axis Mundi. Kentaro and Tim make an unexpected alliance.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: In season one, two siblings look to uncover their family's connection to the secretive organization known as Monarch. Clues lead them into the world of monsters and ultimately down the rabbit hole to Army officer Lee Shaw, taking place in the 1950s and half a century later where Monarch is threatened by what Shaw knows.

episodes.name: Cause and Effect
episodes.overview: Decades after being presumed dead, Keiko's return shocks Monarch. Cate defies orders to save Shaw—and unleashes a terrifying new Titan.

episodes.name: Resonance
episodes.overview: Lee and Keiko investigate a secretive village with a cult devoted to a mysterious creature. Cate crosses paths with a deadly stowaway.

episodes.name: Secrets
episodes.overview: Shaw, Keiko, Hiroshi, and Kentaro go rogue in an attempt to find Titan X. Cate struggles with feelings of guilt. A buried secret is exposed.

episodes.name: Trespass
episodes.overview: To get Hiroshi's device back, Shaw and the team execute a daring heist at Apex Cybernetics.

episodes.name: Furusato
episodes.overview: In Santa Soledad, Titan X becomes a target for Apex, forcing Shaw and the Randas to infiltrate the covert experiment.

episodes.name: Requiem
episodes.overview: Shaw and Suzuki test a "Titan phone" designed to summon Godzilla, triggering an unforeseen event that puts Shaw in the path of his own past.

episodes.name: String Theory
episodes.overview: Shaw receives an impossible radio transmission. Cate and Keiko uncover an ancient link to Titan X. Isabel has a proposition for Kentaro.

episodes.name: Separate Ways
episodes.overview: Titan X makes landfall in Australia, where Shaw lures Godzilla into a showdown. Isabel uses the battle as a distraction for her secret operation.

episodes.name: Ends of the Earth
episodes.overview: Monarch and the team head to Skull Island. Cate tries to reason with Kentaro and stop Isabel. Shaw and Keiko search for Billy's long-lost rift.

episodes.name: Where We Belong
episodes.overview: Kong and Titan X face off in a colossal clash that threatens to reshape Skull Island. Shaw embarks on a dangerous journey.

guest_stars.name: Sahajak Boonthanakit

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: Season two picks up with the fate of Monarch — and the world — hanging in the balance. Buried secrets are revealed that reunite our heroes (and villains) on Kong's Skull Island, and a new, mysterious village where a mythical Titan rises from the sea. The ripple effects of the past make waves in the present day, blurring the bonds between family, friend and foe — all with the threat of a Titan event on the horizon.

reviews.author: ddnnacheta
reviews.content:
More drama than action, adventure, or sci-fi, but a good overall build-up to the coming movie.

Pretty much every episode without a titan was trash IMHO, but it was simply because I was expecting to see more titans and learn more about them. However, if you look at the series title, it says “Monarch” - this is about people (an organisation), not about titans.

That being said, some story elements were inconsistent, like regular humans surviving a building dropping on their heads and coming out with a “broken” leg that they can walk on without a cane? I've had a broken leg before, and I couldn't walk.

So, regardless of my disappointment about the lack of titans, there were other elements that made this not live up to its potential.

Lastly, a few of the episodes did well in giving the audience an idea of what to expect in the future film, and I'm looking forward to seeing it on the big screen.
